    q=s.targets[:7].copy()
    for _ in range(15):c.step(q,grip=1,base=[.12,0,0])
    c.hold(5,grip=1)
    a=s.targets.copy();a[8]=.15;a[12]=1
    for _ in range(20):s.step(a)
    c.hold(5,grip=1)
    q=s.targets[:7].copy()
    for _ in range(25):c.step(q,grip=1,base=[0,.15,0])
    c.hold(5,grip=1)
    for _ in range(20):c.step(q,grip=1,base=[0,.45,0])
    c.hold(8,grip=1)
    for _ in range(20):c.step(q,grip=1,base=[.45,0,0])
    c.hold(8,grip=1)
    for _ in range(20):c.step(q,grip=1,base=[.6,-.45,0])
    c.hold(8,grip=1)
    c.step(s.targets[:7],grip=1,base=[.6,-.45,0])
    c.move(pdrop+[0,0,.14],c.top(yaw),n=70,grip=1)
    c.move([2.895,-3.065,1.00],c.top(yaw),n=50,grip=1,settle=5)
    c.hold(15,grip=-1)
    c.move([2.77,-3.03,1.3],c.top(yaw),n=45,grip=-1)
    aspR=d.xmat[m.body('asparagus_main').id].reshape(3,3).copy()
    ayaw=np.arctan2(aspR[1,0],aspR[0,0]);atarget=c.obj('asparagus')

    c.move(atarget+[0,0,.012],c.top(ayaw),n=45,settle=5)
    c.hold(18,grip=1)
    c.move(atarget+[0,0,.18],c.top(ayaw),n=50,grip=1)
    atarget=c.obj('asparagus')
    aspR=d.xmat[m.body('asparagus_main').id].reshape(3,3)
    ayaw=np.arctan2(aspR[1,0],aspR[0,0])
    c.move(atarget+[0,0,.003],c.top(ayaw),n=50,settle=5)
    c.hold(25,grip=1)
    c.move(atarget+[0,0,.12],c.top(ayaw),n=70,grip=1)

    c.status()
    assert s.check()['success'],s.check()
    s.save_trajectory()
    return s

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /app/output/parameterized_controller.py <<'PY'
from controller import Controller as BaseController
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
class Controller(BaseController):
 def move(self,p,R=None,n=40,grip=-1,settle=8,verbose=True):
  R=self.rot() if R is None else R
  start=self.pos();startR=self.rot();p=np.asarray(p)
  delta=Rotation.from_matrix(R@startR.T).as_rotvec()
  q=self.s.data.qpos[self.qids].copy();path=[q.copy()]
  # Precompute an original IK path. This changes only a separate kinematic data buffer.
  for i in range(1,101):
   u=i/100;u=u*u*(3-2*u)
   q,ep,er=self.ik(start+(p-start)*u,Rotation.from_rotvec(delta*u).as_matrix()@startR,q)
   path.append(q.copy())
  path=np.asarray(path)
  duration=max(n/20,np.max(np.abs(np.diff(path,axis=0)))*100/getattr(self,'max_speed',1.2),np.sqrt(np.max(np.abs(np.diff(path,n=2,axis=0)))*10000/getattr(self,'max_acceleration',4.)))
  n=max(4,int(np.ceil(duration*20)))
  for i in range(1,n+1):
   u=i/n*100;k=min(int(u),99);q=path[k]+(path[k+1]-path[k])*(u-k)
   self.step(q,grip)
  self.hold(settle,grip)
  if verbose:print('move',len(self.s.actions),'duration_steps',n,'eef',self.pos().round(4),'target',p.round(4),'IK',ep,er,'success',self.s.success,flush=True)
